decisions.reason: The composition impact is already fully represented by the existing message-167 MODIFY, which records the reduced E/L scale and resulting hierarchy; no correction or additional Event is needed.
The existing message-167 MODIFY already records the selected Option 1 proportional reduction, unchanged second-V scale, and use of its left arm as the alphabet scale reference.
The source keeps the Hero V and second V geometry unchanged and adjusts only the E and L scale, so the approved Hero V requirement remains valid without modification.
The source does not change the É accent's derivation, geometry, alignment, or locked status.
Using the second V's left arm as a visual scale reference for the E and L does not alter the shared signature-terminal treatment or its permitted application.
The letter-scale refinement supports the existing hierarchy but does not necessarily change any current brand-expression attribute.
The source concerns black-and-white letter proportions and has no effect on the deferred champagne-gold material treatment.
Adjusting the E and L scale does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
